answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 32825 Country: India Title: How to manage situation between mother & wife? Question: After marriage, my mother is not liking my wife. my mother is torturing her in different ways.my wife is innocent, talented & educated. she tolerates every thing but blame me for this. my mother is also abusing me. i am not in a position to tackle all the problems and losing my health & mental power day by day. pls suggest me how can i overcome it? Answer ID: 32825 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1037/630/L=1432) Ask your wife to have patience. Both of you should recite حسبنا الله و نعم الوكيل five hundred times in one meeting or several meetings daily with wudhu. In-sha-Allah, your trouble shall go away. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
